critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED: saved.tsx had duplicate content - the new SavedScreen (with tabs) at lines 1-288 was followed by the OLD SavedScreen code (lines 289-469) including a second 'export default function SavedScreen()'. This caused Babel SyntaxError: 'Identifier timeAgo has already been declared' → Metro bundler 500 error → blank white app. Fixed by removing lines 289-469 (old duplicate code). The 's' StyleSheet at line 471+ already contains all needed styles including tabs/tab/tabActive etc.

rca_of_issue.bug: saved.tsx SyntaxError - Babel parse failure causing Metro bundler 500 error
rca_of_issue.root_cause: When the main agent added the new SavedScreen with tabs (lines 1-288), the OLD SavedScreen code was not removed - it was left appended in the same file starting at line 289. This created duplicate function declarations: 'timeAgo' declared twice, 'SavedCard' declared twice, 'card' StyleSheet declared twice, and two 'export default function SavedScreen()'. The TypeScript/Babel parser threw: 'Identifier timeAgo has already been declared'
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Removed duplicate old code (lines 289-469 of the original 511-line file) while keeping the new SavedScreen (lines 1-288) and the unified 's' StyleSheet (lines 470-511 / now 289-330 in the fixed file). The 's' StyleSheet already includes all needed styles for both old and new components including tabs/tab/tabActive/tabText/tabTextActive
rca_of_issue.reproduction_steps: 1. Navigate to saved.tsx 2. Check for duplicate 'export default function' 3. Metro bundler log shows: ERROR SyntaxError: Identifier 'timeAgo' has already been declared
